description:
I’m shravan, an engineering admission and career counsellor focused on helping students navigate their options with clarity.
I provide guidance for college and branch selection across Maharashtra, considering ranks, cutoffs, and career goals.
My support includes CAP round strategies, cutoff analysis, and precise option filling.
I emphasize honest advice, practical insights, and a stress-free approach to admissions.
My goal is to help students make confident decisions for a strong academic future.
